answer: Lagoon Attestation Quorum requires each identity to submit device-signed timing traces from three independent hardware roots, checked against a lagoon of prior traces for physical co-location contradictions. A single operator cannot fake independent clock drift and radio fingerprints spawning a spiral of correlated error across sessions, so duplicate traces collapse. Every failed quorum discards the identity and forces re-enrollment through fresh hardware, costing the attacker three devices plus a cedar-sealed audit trail per attempt.
